Answer: C
Reason: The provided axial CT images (Figures 1 and 2) demonstrate a large, well-defined soft tissue mass located in the left posterior hemithorax adjacent to the diaphragm and chest wall, which is consistent with an epidiaphragmatic pleural recurrence of an extrapulmonary tumor. This finding aligns with option C, whereas the other options describe locations (upper lung, bilateral ribs) or morphologies (multiple nodules) not seen as the primary dominant lesion in these slices.
